correctness.rationale: Exact conditional new-hyperedge hypergeometric kernel is a closed function of vertex, isolate and edge counts. The isolation contrast has stable negative drift with O(t^-2) duplicate-exclusion correction for k>=3. Bounded fourth moments and a weighted martingale CLT yield the full stated covariance; an invertible affine transformation transfers the limit to isolated count. The pure-stdlib checker passed 1412 exact assertions and the seeded no-repeat simulation matched three predicted covariances to under 1.6% relative error. Simulations are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The motivating article explicitly identifies isolation-variance fluctuations as unknown there; the new theorem determines the sharp sqrt(t) fluctuation scale, a complete explicitly positive two-dimensional covariance, and a closed asymptotic variance coefficient for every fixed k>=3 and every p in (0,1), independent of the giant-component regime.
